description: Set or re-issue the org's journey from a template (write — ADMIN role). Merges by stage key: attestations survive; dropping an attested stage is refused (409). An uploaded `template` wins outright.

activate.description: Start the first stage immediately (default false)

practitioner_name.description: The consultancy or practitioner recorded as having set this journey up

template.description: A practitioner-authored journey artefact to upload. When present it wins over template_key entirely.

name.description: Journey name shown to the organization (default 'Compliance journey')

stages.description: The ordered stages — at least one

expect_next.description: What the organization should expect once this stage passes

key.description: Stable stage identifier, unique within the journey (e.g. 'scoping')

precondition_spec.description: Machine-checked preconditions evaluated for display only — they never advance a stage on their own. Each entry is {type, label?, ...params}; an unknown type or a parameter the type does not take reads as 'cannot evaluate', never as met. Types: frameworks_scoped(min_count); controls_with_decision, controls_with_owner(min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); controls_at_status(statuses, min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); controls_at_risk_max(max_count, domains, scf_ids); documents_approved(min_count, generator e.g. 'soa' or '<generator>:<domain>' such as 'policy:GOV', within_days 1–3660 = approved in the last N days); evidence_items_tracked(min_count); evidence_files_uploaded(min_count); evidence_upload_spread_days(min_days, default 30); engagement_exists; frameworks_with_basis(basis mcr|dsr required, min_count); controls_with_basis(basis?, min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); systems_with_criticality(min_fraction); controls_with_target, controls_at_target(min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); material_controls_at_status(statuses required, min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); risks_accepted_without_approver_max(max_count, default 0); open_deficiencies_max, material_deficiencies_max(max_count default 0, domains); controls_validated_within_cadence(min_fraction, domains, scf_ids); capability_tests_within_days(days 1–3660 required, min_count default 1, test_types: incident_response|continuity|other). scf_ids and domains apply only where listed; an unknown control ID or domain code is refused at upload (422). Example: {"type": "documents_approved", "generator": "soa"}. Full table: docs/tools/journey.md

summary.description: What this stage covers, in the practitioner's words

title.description: Stage name as the organization should read it

template_version.description: Version of the artefact, as the practitioner tracks it

template_key.description: Template to import, e.g. 'compliancegenie-default' — obtain from scf_list_journey_templates. Ignored when `template` is supplied.

name: scf_import_journey
